test_title: SSC MTS Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Eight boys Ram, Sumit, Sunil, Rahul, Raj, Aman, Amit and Anil are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Anil is not the immediate neighbour of Raj or Rahul. Anil is to the immediate left of Ram. Amit is the immediate neighbour of Raj. Aman is to the immediate right of Sumit. Sunil is sitting between Raj and Aman. Who is the immediate neighbour of both Raj and Anil?
solution:
Eight boys Ram, Sumit, Sunil, Rahul, Raj, Aman, Amit and Anil are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order).

1) Aman is to the immediate right of Sumit and Sunil is sitting between Raj and Aman. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/938a09e48c839683eec7d462dced45b6452691f37a54353007e912427fa5f354.png] 

2) Amit is the immediate neighbour of Raj.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1156aaf37c57ee726e6bc9e5abc6e31eedc3c8dced5f5125c9e4848b26547f0b.png] 

3) Anil is not the immediate neighbour of Raj or Rahul and Anil is to the immediate left of Ram.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8cd9a929f8a1f47a330456bca7ffbb3a2d8a4e32128bfceb35daea568e47a250.png] 

∴ Here, 'Amit' is the immediate neighbour of both Raj and Anil.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Amit".**
